stemMd: Which electromagnetic wave has the greatest frequency among radio waves, microwaves, visible light, ultraviolet and X-rays?
explanationMd: Frequency increases through radio, microwave, visible, ultraviolet and X-ray ranges. All are electromagnetic radiation, but their wavelengths differ inversely with frequency in vacuum. X-rays are therefore highest among the listed categories.

distractorRationale.e: Radio waves lie at the low-frequency end of these choices.
distractorRationale.a: Microwaves have lower frequency than visible, ultraviolet and X-rays.
distractorRationale.b: Visible light is below ultraviolet and X-rays in frequency.
distractorRationale.c: Ultraviolet is above visible light but below X-rays in frequency.
